verdicts.reason: Both candidates are practically identical; the only difference is a small shift of the bottom tape strip over the photo. Both share the same flaws: the treatment checklist is broken, with six checkmarks next to three run-together lines ('Chin Upper lip Ears', 'Chest Bikini Area') that don't line up with the checks. Also, the two top tape strips float in empty space above the card instead of holding it, the woman's face is cut off at the top of the photo, and MUSELIO.PT sits awkwardly beside the $50 instead of acting as a sign-off.
